6662-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

883-2946-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
883-2946-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
883-2946-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4681-5170-6495-8175.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
4681-5170-6495-8175.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2169-4694-7306-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-4694-7306-8095.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

339-647-677-728.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5541-5571-6495--6.description:
Use Bazaar Trader to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2.
5541-5571-6495--6.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

413-3197-5662--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures also triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat from step 7.

4050-4986-7896--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Mirkwood Nurturer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mirkwood Nurturer enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mirkwood Nurturer
Repeat.
4050-4986-7896--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

2963-7009-7803.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
2963-7009-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2963-7009-7803.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Brad Boimler.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

997-3249-4647-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7728.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Voracious Brood.
When Voracious Brood dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3946-5448-7705.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1274-6823-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-6823-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5086-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Triskelavus.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

500-2081-3191-6913.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Chameleon and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Chameleon dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Chameleon tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-2081-3191-6913.notes: The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

457-1903-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-1903-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

930-4693-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3293-5413-5531.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
You do not have any static effects boosting your creatures' toughness.
3293-5413-5531.description:
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
When you sacrifice the last land, Lumra will die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Lumra trigger from step 2, causing you to mill four cards and return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
3293-5413-5531.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

5080-5909.description:
Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters, it triggers, causing each player to exile all but the bottom six cards of their library.
Cast Maddening Cacophony by paying {1}{U}, causing each opponent to mill the rest of their library.

2316-5231-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-5231-6441.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

628-2018-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Carrion Feeder didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Carrion Feeder from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Carrion Feeder from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Carrion Feeder is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
628-2018-2438.notes: You may instead sacrifice another nontoken creature that isn't a Human and does not have flying instead of Carrion Feeder.

3765-5864-6102.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3765-5864-6102.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
3765-5864-6102.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

488-1414-1482-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites: One of either Jeweled Lotus or Lotus Petal must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1414-1482-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2239-2254-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 2 or less.
2239-2254-5626.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing Ardent Elementalist, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Ardent Elementalist's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

969-1409-2661.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Gwenna.
969-1409-2661.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Gwenna by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Gwenna enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbound ability triggers, repairing it and Gwenna.
Repeat.

586-1799-2034-2048.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Priest of Gix on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Priest of Gix into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3363-3823.notablePrerequisites:
Time Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
The One Ring does not have an Aura attached.
3363-3823.description:
Activate Time Elemental by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, returning The One Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.

4112-4753.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Clever Impersonator enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Clever Impersonator triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.
